name: Umajin XR Assistant
summary:
# Real-time, expert guidance, delivered in extended reality.

Umajin XR Assistant is an enterprise XR solution designed to support frontline workers performing tasks by connecting them with a remote expert through real-time 3D collaboration.

The application supports two user roles:

**Expert**

Experts can host a live XR session. They see a real-time 2D view of the worker's environment and can guide tasks using:
- Live voice and video communication
- Create spatially anchored digital canvases in the on-sit
